name: whisperbox_respond
description: Answer one WhisperBox form, opened from a link or by another app (intent whisperbox.respond, with a link or a form file the app ships; the reply says whether an answer was sent). Answers are sealed end to end: only the form's creators can read them. Uses the whisperbox_core engine; making and managing forms is the WhisperBox studio.

params.name: form
params.description: A form file exported from the WhisperBox studio (its JSON text): the form opens without being looked up on the network. Give link or form.
